findings: ZIP 80545 (Red Fe Lks) has 10 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (70%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80545 (Red Fe Lks) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
